g.text: F169.5 the phone: the interface design
the sheet draws the sidebar first (step 2)
running down: a card a row, one trunk (step 5)
a flow: down, no columns, no row gap
cards: down, when one card feeds the rail

text.tspan: Two new types, both in the engine:
the fit a drawing is asked for, and what answers a picture's narrow form. A trunk is the one new placed record. Everything else is there and changes, each change marked with its step.
